title: Parlermonium: A Data-Driven UX Design Evaluation of the Parler Platform
reasoning: The paper's central thesis involves an evaluation of a social media platform's design and its relationship with the ethical and legal concept of "free speech." It analyzes how design choices can be conducive to the spread of misinformation and foster echo chambers, which are topics with significant ethical implications for public discourse. This evaluation of platform design through an ethical lens forms a core component of the research, rather than being a peripheral consideration.
